meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about the zero on Owen's essay. Who decided it?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Did anyone speak to Owen before you entered it?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He could have written it somewhere else and pasted it in. And you still haven't said whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero.
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine, he'll bring it. Whatever comes of this, it stays off his record and it stays out of his classroom. And that's twice you've skipped whether Owen was heard first.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Hale, kids misquote, and editions differ. Is it anywhere in the play at all?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. What are you proposing, and is anything on his record right now?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Arguments change after an outline; that's the point of one. And you keep showing me pages instead of answering me. Tell me what's on his record.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4, in writing tonight, and I'll hold you to every word of it. Owen does the rewrite to put this behind him, nothing more. Give me a date.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth, he'll be there. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a private supervised rewrite of Owen's essay under procedure 4.4, after school on Thursday, November 12, not in front of his class, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require a plain answer to whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero was entered, and that commitment in writing. I expect that written commitment from you tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth with nothing on his record, and she still wants an answer on whether Owen was heard before the zero; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You let her search Act 3, Scene 2 for the line the essay quotes and answered her misquote defence, which gave her something she could check herself.
What cost ground: You never answered whether Owen was spoken to before the zero, though she asked three times, and that gap will go straight to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with edits between 11:31 and 11:58 PM the night before the essay was due, came very close to that kind of night, and she went shorter and harder right there; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether anyone spoke to Owen before you entered the zero, answer it plainly in one sentence before you turn your laptop to her.
